VHX Replacement Parts




Here are the replacement parts for VHX analog gauge systems, starting with the VHX control box.

The 391183 rocker switch assembly replaces the separate 250015 switches and works only with VHX systems. Mount it under the dash, or remove the switch and run it through the dash. Cat 5 cables, BIM daisy-chain cables, an oil pressure harness, a turn signal harness and a 16K speed generator are listed. The water temp sender reads 100-300 degrees F and the solid-state oil pressure sender reads 0-100 psi, each with a 10 ft harness. A small block Chevy oil pressure adaptor, bushings in several sizes and a Ford adaptor are listed too.

130070: Small Block Chevy Oil Pressure Adaptor 

It’s no secret that the small block Chevy doesn’t allow much space for an oil pressure sensor. For years, enthusiasts hit the hardware store in search of a few brass fittings to move the sensor up and away from the intake and distributor. This one-piece machined adapter gives you the clearance and flexibility you need in one convenient solution. The 130070 is machined in the USA with a male 1/8” NPT thread to fit your block, plus two female 1/8” NPT threads to accept the sensor of your choice. The female ports are at 45 and 90 degrees, allowing maximum flexibility for a variety of situations. A 1/8” NPT pipe-plug is included to block off the unused port. 

SEN-01-5 - GM Speed Generator 16k PPM

Includes 10 foot wire harness.

May work with Chrysler/ Mopar Transmissions please check your transmission for proper fitment. GM generator requires a 7/8" male thread to screw onto transmission housing.
 

SEN-01-5 With Ford/Tremec Adaptor 620006 -
Tremec/Ford Speed Generator 16k PPM.
 

Includes 10 foot wire harness.

May work with Chrysler/ Mopar Transmissions please check your transmission for proper fitment. Ford generator requires that the supplied mounting tab be bolted to the transmission housing.
